title: Artemisia Gentileschi's birth chart
metaDescription: Artemisia Gentileschi's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 16.0° Cancer. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Cardinal signs carry five of the ten placements whose signs are settled — the broadest certain weighting in the chart. Cardinal weight is read as initiative: the instinct to be the reason something began.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun sits at 16.0° Cancer — the second decan, 10°–20°, which the tradition sub-rules by Mars. Degrees matter more than the sign label here: two people born a fortnight apart share Cancer and share almost nothing else about where the Sun actually stood.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: The personal planets sit Mercury at 25.8° Gemini, Venus at 8.1° Leo, Mars at 13.1° Pisces. Mercury in an air sign reads as a mind at home in argument and pattern; Venus in a fire sign reads as taste that runs toward the vivid and the immediate; Mars in a water sign reads as drive that moves on certainty and current.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Jupiter to Pluto is the closest call of the day, a square within 0.3°. Right angles are where the scheme puts its grit. A square asks two functions to work in a mode neither would have chosen. Behind it, Venus trine Uranus at 1.2°, and the Sun square Pluto at 1.3° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. Each angle here was measured at every hour of the civil day and held; whatever the missing clock said, this geometry was in it.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: The Sun opposes Jupiter while both square Pluto. The t-square is the figure the old texts trusted for output: friction with a fixed address. The Moon stands apart from every major angle the day held — the tradition reads an unaspected planet as a voice that speaks on its own schedule, unmodulated by the rest of the chart.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Of the seven planets the classical scheme judges, four sit in a sign it has an opinion about. The Moon in Scorpio at 20.0° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Mercury in Gemini at 25.8° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Jupiter in Capricorn at 17.6° is in fall; Saturn in Cancer at 28.6° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain. Condition, not character: that is all the dignity table ever measured.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: The certain ground: 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, dividing 4 water, 4 fire, 1 air, 1 earth by element and 5 cardinal, 3 fixed, 2 mutable by mode. Water reads the room before the room speaks — atmosphere first, analysis later. Venus and Jupiter were retrograde — apparent retreat against the stars, which the old reading takes as a function working from the inside first.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Scorpio for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 12.2° between midnight and midnight. The missing clock moves the Moon by half a sign at most here, and the boundary was never close. At the noon reference it stands at 20.0°.
